text:
Maya (CSM): Quick capture from this morning's onboarding with JetRail — felt like three discrete asks + an urgent renewal signal (renewal in ~60d). Putting raw notes here so we can prioritize.
Jordan (PM): thanks — can you paste the asks? prioritize by biz/tech impact if possible.
Maya (CSM): Sure — raw snippets from the call: 
- Ask A: 'Per-route cost breakdown in Console' — customer can't attribute token spend to microservices; needs per-route and per-model cost across teams. Said they'd increase committed spend if granularity exists.
- Ask B: 'Embedding refresh + TTL controls' — their pipeline reindexes nightly; they want a TTL + webhook to re-embed changed records instead of full refresh. Current pain: infra cost spikes and staleness.
- Ask C: 'SDK hook for streaming partial embeddings + backpressure' — they stream high-QPS and want a lightweight client-side way to pause/retry without dropping batches.
Also flagged: "renewal is tied to cost predictability" (customer comment).
Liam (Eng): thx. quick technical take: A is mostly UI + billing-event tagging work (medium dev), B needs new API + some indexer changes (medium-high), C is client SDK + small runtime changes (low-medium).
Jordan (PM): rough effort vs impact matrix would help the CSMs when we negotiate. Can you add short RICE-ish bullets?
Maya (CSM): RICE-ish: 
- A: Reach = high (all teams), Impact = high (commits), Confidence = medium, Effort = medium -> score ~ 62
- B: Reach = medium, Impact = high (reduces costs), Confidence = medium-low, Effort = high -> score ~ 44
- C: Reach = medium, Impact = medium (resilience), Confidence = high, Effort = low -> score ~ 58
Jordan (PM): interesting — A then C then B by that scoring. I want to add one product constraint: per-route cost needs aligned telemetry first, so A might be blocked by infra events. Liam, any blockers we should call out?
Liam (Eng): telemetry pipeline needs an event tag (route_id + model_id) from runtime. That's a ~2-sprint infra task unless we short-circuit with sampling + SDK tags as a stopgap (1 sprint).
Maya (CSM): proposal: short-term: add SDK tags + Console filter (1 sprint) to unblock renewals. Medium-term: infra tagging + billing export (2 sprints). Long-term: embedding TTL + webhook work scheduled after infra deploy.
Jordan (PM): agree. Can you capture this as a 2-step launch plan that the renewals team can reference? I'll carve out dev capacity for the stopgap if it helps the renewal decision.
Maya (CSM): will do. tagging plan + one-pager by EOD. Also adding CS Bot note: logged feature-ask ticket #CS-7869 (basic tags) and #CS-7870 (embed-ttl).
CS Bot: Automated note: ticket CS-7869 created by Maya; status = triage.
Liam (Eng): FYI, if we do SDK tagging, I can prototype a patch for JS + Python clients in ~3 days.
Jordan (PM): cool. next steps: Maya to share one-pager + customer quote; Jordan to confirm slot for stopgap dev; Liam to prototype SDK tags. Follow up in 72h. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): thanks — pinging renewal owner in case they want to join the 72h checkpoint.
Jordan (PM): @renewals-team please note — JetRail renewal tied to cost visibility; stopgap tagging recommended.
Maya (CSM): end of thread: I'll upload the one-pager to the renewal folder and link back here.
